Title: Icon-based step navigation with progress state
Description: Replace the long scrolling flow with clickable navigation for Upload, Pre-Validation, Issues, Auto-Fix, Post-Validation, Compare, and Export, with visible step state and top progress bar.
Acceptance Criteria: Users can move between all seven steps from the side navigation; current step is highlighted; top progress bar reflects current state; Issues page is reachable in 2 clicks; navigation works on common desktop viewport sizes.
Dependencies: Existing page flow and route/state model.

Title: Default issue filter to Fail and Warn plus Show Passed toggle
Description: Reduce review noise by hiding passed checks by default and adding a toggle to reveal them only when needed.
Acceptance Criteria: Issue list defaults to Fail and Warn only; passed items are hidden on first load; Show Passed toggle reveals and hides passed items without losing other filters; result counters stay accurate.
Dependencies: Validation results UI and result status model.

Title: Downloadable Pre-Validation report export
Description: Generate a downloadable pre-validation report for every run in both PDF and JSON formats.
Acceptance Criteria: UI provides one-click export for pre-validation; PDF and JSON contain summary, issue list, run ID, timestamp, and source file name; export works for all completed validation runs.
Dependencies: Validation result schema and file export service.

Title: Downloadable Post-Validation report export
Description: Generate a downloadable post-validation report after auto-fix and post-validation processing in both PDF and JSON formats.
Acceptance Criteria: UI provides one-click export for post-validation; PDF and JSON contain summary, resolved items, unresolved items, run ID, timestamp, and output file reference; export works for all completed post-validation runs.
Dependencies: Auto-fix/post-validation output schema and file export service.

Title: Comparison report with rule-level delta and unresolved items
Description: Create a before-versus-after comparison report that highlights rule-level deltas, resolved items, unresolved items, and newly introduced failures.
Acceptance Criteria: Users can open a comparison report from a completed run; report shows pre and post status for each changed rule; unresolved items are clearly highlighted; export is available from the UI; users can identify unresolved items in under 1 minute.
Success Metric: Users identify unresolved items in under 1 minute.
Dependencies: SP1-03; SP1-04; run IDs and artifact linking.

Title: Run IDs and immutable artifact snapshots
Description: Store a unique run ID and immutable snapshots for input, pre-validation output, post-validation output, and generated fixed artifacts.
Acceptance Criteria: Every run is assigned a unique run ID; input hash is stored; pre and post artifacts can be retrieved by run ID; snapshot content cannot be overwritten in place; output files are linked back to the original input hash.
Success Metric: Every output linked to an input hash.
Dependencies: Persistent storage for run metadata and artifacts.

Title: EPUB-first default workflow
Description: Make EPUB the default and recommended input route across the UI and workflow copy, while keeping PDF available as a slower path.
Acceptance Criteria: EPUB is preselected or visually promoted as the primary path; upload hints explain why EPUB is faster; PDF option remains available; workflow copy is updated consistently.
Success Metric: Lower median processing time for standard workflows.
Dependencies: Upload UI copy and accepted-format hinting.

Title: Asynchronous PDF conversion queue with progress tracking
Description: Move PDF conversion into an asynchronous job flow so the UI stays responsive and users can track progress.
Acceptance Criteria: PDF conversion no longer blocks the main request flow; system exposes queued, running, completed, and failed states; UI shows live or refreshable progress; users can leave and return to the job without losing state.
Success Metric: No UI freeze during conversion jobs.
Dependencies: Background job runner or queue service; SP1-07.

Title: Embedded JavaScript policy detection and severity reporting
Description: Define and implement a clear JavaScript handling policy covering detection, classification, allow or block or sandbox behavior, and report severity.
Acceptance Criteria: Validation identifies embedded JavaScript presence; each finding is classified with severity and policy outcome; report explains whether content is allowed, blocked, or sandboxed; no JavaScript finding returns an ambiguous state.
Dependencies: Validation rule updates and report schema support.

Title: Landing page upload guidance and CTA cleanup
Description: Improve the first-run experience with plain-language EPUB explanation, feature cards, clearer upload hints, sample files, processing estimate, and stronger call-to-action flow.
Acceptance Criteria: Landing page explains what EPUB is in plain language; feature cards highlight Validation, Auto-Fix, Compare, Download Report, and Run History; upload component shows accepted formats and sample files; CTAs for Start Validation, Run Auto-Fix, and Download Report are clearly visible.
Success Metric: Improved first-run clarity and lower support dependency.
Dependencies: Landing page content and upload component updates.
